description: This dataset contains sediment geochemistry measurements from the Santiurde section, located at latitude 43.0685608 and longitude -4.0878295 with an elevation of 730 meters. It includes nineteen unique samples identified by specific IDs and labels, recording stratigraphic height, thickness, and various mineral compositions such as quartz, clay, calcite, gypsum, dolomite, and pyrite. The data captures physical properties like sample ratios alongside detailed mineral percentages. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze sedimentary structures, understand geological formations, and study the geochemical evolution of the site. The dataset serves as a valuable resource for geologists investigating stratigraphic variations and mineral distribution in terrestrial environments.
